name: Roland GAIA-2
description: Roland GAIA-2 wavetable/virtual-analog synthesizer: the temporary tone — its control, common, MFX, reverb/delay, chorus, arpeggio, step-sequencer and motional-pad settings, the GAIA-2 model (LFOs, three oscillators, partial) and the Analog Synth Model used by SH-101 tones. Every edit-buffer block of the MIDI Implementation except the sequencer and motional-pad recordings.

sources.title: GAIA2 MIDI Implementation (version 1.00, Sep. 1, 2023)

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

A tone is Temporary Tone Ext (01 00 00 00) plus one model: the GAIA2 Model (02 40 00 00) for GAIA-2 tones, or the Analog Synth Model (02 10 00 00) for SH-101 Model Expansion tones. Only the model the current tone uses is live.
Identity: the manual's printed Identity Reply (p5) has family code 06 05; its explanation table says 65 03, the JUPITER-X's. 06 05 is used; unconfirmed on hardware.
Tone Sequencer Data and Tone Motional Pad Data are left out: recordings, not sound parameters, and larger than one 256-byte message.
The tone name (ToneCom, p8) is printed as sixteen rows all called "Name", so it comes out as sixteen one-character parameters (gaia2Tone.name, gaia2Tone.name_0801 … _080F) rather than one text field.

Analog Model AMP MOD (p95) is printed with a wire range of (-100 - 100) on a two-nibble value; every neighbouring ±100 parameter is (28 - 228). Transcribed as printed, so analog.ampMod defaults to -100 and the engine refuses to send anything below 0.
Not read at startup (read on request, since the instrument may not answer them): lfo, osc, partial, gaia2Tone, analog, analogTone.

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: the CC Map (OFF / TONE CC / PANEL CC, System Common) is not listed in the MIDI Implementation
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: MFX and reverb/delay parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list. MFX Type and REV Type are plain numbers: the MFX type names are a separate, non-contiguous table (appendix 1, p101), and no REV type names are printed
coverage.sequencerData: not included: Tone Sequencer Data (3,072 step values, pp15-94) and Tone Motional Pad Data (200 positions, pp10-14)

parameters.name: AMP MOD
parameters.description: The manual prints -100 - 100 as this value's wire range, which this encoding cannot carry; read-only until an instrument shows the real wire values.
